Harper Grenywald is a human ranger and Harper. Depending on if one of the original Harper allies are dead, he can take their place and help the party during the Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during Confront the Elder Brain.
“
I hope... I hope we get a chance to see to the dead.
„
— Grenywald

Involvement

Act Two

Assault Moonrise Towers

If  Isobel is saved, and the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers, Grenywald takes the place of one of the original Harper allies (either  Antony,  Essius,  Lymn, or  Naysa) as a failsafe in the event that one the latter has been killed before the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers. Speaking with Grenywald lets him awkwardly compliment the player character.[1]

If he survives the fight, he guards the first floor of Moonrise Towers with the remaining Harpers.[2]

Act Three

If Grenywald survives Moonrise Towers, he can be summoned as an ally through the  Gather Your Allies variant  Silver Harp Squadron, if ⁠The High Harper is completed with  Minsc alive, and either Antony, Naysa, or Lymn being dead.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ "Ilmater's ashes, but I hope you're half the fighter you look." - Grenywald
    The player character then proceeds to raise an eyebrow in confusion, unsure of whether or not it was a compliment.
  2. ↑ If killed during the Assault on Moonrise Towers, a replacement Harper failsafe (either Lanni or Olys), or a generic Harper Archer takes his place as a  Silver Harp Squadron summon.
  3. ↑ Grenywald has four level 1 spell slots, and two level 2 spell slots, despite having no spell to cast.
  4. ↑ Unlike the original Harper allies, who are unable to attack twice during a turn despite having the Extra Attack feature, Grenywald is not affected by this bug.
  5. ↑ When summoned during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain, Grenywald has an unlimited  Arrow of Lightning supply to use.
  6. ↑ Grenywald has a  Harp-Shaped Pin pinned on his chest.
